Capacity refused: it must be a number between 10 and 200 kWh.
Health refused: it must be a number between 50 and 110 %%.
Minimum power refused: it must be a number between 3 and 400 kW.
Reserve refused: it must be a number between 0 and 40 %%.

The defaults are an MG4 Long Range specification sheet — a figure describing the model, not this car — with the pack assumed intact because nothing in this app has measured its age. Capacity and health only convert the route\'s climb into charge; the rest of the forecast comes from what you have actually spent per kilometre.
